comment: A conversation as a row of steps and what it has become after them (D-294, D-304, D-305). A step is a line of Claude Code, or something the person does. The answer is the state, the feed and every line written to Claude Code on the way. The queue is kept by Aiko: a message sent during a turn, or while a card waits, goes out when the turn is over. A turn that ended does not free the session while a subagent still runs. What a subagent says inside its own work stays out of the feed; its requests do not. glance is the conversation as the list of sessions sees it: what it does and the parts of the one line about it.
